extracted.name: Breakfast Oat Bowls
extracted.description: These overnight breakfast oat bowls are endlessly customizable. Try one of the variations in the post above, or experiment with different spices, nut butters, nuts, seeds, or fruit.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup almond milk or light coconut milk (more as needed)
instruction_lines: In a small jar, combine the oats, almond or coconut milk, maple syrup, and salt. Stir and chill overnight.
In the morning, scoop the oats into a bowl, stir in more almond or coconut milk, if desired, for consistency. Top with desired toppings.
Alternatively, for a grab-and-go breakfast, you can assemble the oats in jars with the toppings the night before.
